items.text: Help Spotting Planes. Best way is to look at one spot for 2-3 seconds.
Turbulence. Uncomfortable for us, but no danger to the aircraft.
Ears. Let me know if you feel pain. Swallow or yawn as we climb & descend
Questions (now or in-flight). No talking during takeoff and landing
Seatbelts at all times. No smoking.
If there's anything I do with the airplane that makes you uncomfortable, let me know right away.
If you feel queasy tell me right away, look outside, nearest vent. Location of airsickness bags.
Don't touch the anything without asking! If seat slips on takeoff, don't grab the yoke. Rudders.
Intercom is voice activated. I do checklists aloud.
Radio callsign. Stop talking during incoming radio traffic. Hand up.
Door – you control it & don't slam it
Emergency Exit procedure (through door). Other exits
Altitude change when VFR on TOP
Loss of any Nav or Com
Compulsory points or fixes in clearance
Leave off if engine is running rough
If no restart, then turn Boost OFF
Indicates high voltage due to voltage regulator exceeding limits
Indicates low voltage due to alternator malfunction, belt or breaker
Airspeed or squat switch failed. 3 lights on: GR SAFETY BYPASS switch, GEAR DN, IN TRANSIT. Gear horn will sound.
Push GEAR CONT breaker back in to extend gear.
If no EFC given, at ETA time
If no EFC given proceed to IAF and begin approach at ETA time
Color Green: Ground Takeoff / Flight Land
Flashing Green: Ground Taxi / Flight Return to land
Red: Ground Stop / Flight Yield and circle
Flashing Red: Ground Taxi clear of runway / Flight Airport Unsafe
Flashing White: Ground Return to start pt. / Flight N/A
